S-01.scenario: Client quotes a 10% discount from an ad; manager corrects it to the allowed 3% for full payment
S-01.trap: The 10% is said by the CLIENT: attributing it to the manager gives a false CORRECT_PROMISE

S-02.scenario: Down payment 20% said in words (below the 30% minimum); 'two years' installment is compliant
S-02.trap: Number in Azerbaijani words: if the value comes back as 'iyirmi', the code cannot read it and misses the violation

S-03.scenario: Handover 'second quarter of next year' = 2027-04, earlier than the declared 2027-10; no showroom invite
S-03.trap: Relative date in Azerbaijani: the model must compute the quarter from the call date

S-04.scenario: Russian transliterated into Latin with ASR errors ('demo rezidens', 'skitku'); 5% discount exceeds the 3% maximum
S-04.trap: Garbled project name and garbled word for discount

S-05.scenario: Azerbaijani written in Cyrillic (ASR setting); price 1,900 AZN per m2 is below the 2,000 minimum
S-05.trap: Script the prompt does not mention: Azerbaijani in Cyrillic

S-06.scenario: Two promises in one sentence: 36-month installment (violation) and 30% down payment (compliant); showroom without a time
S-06.trap: One line holds a violating and a compliant promise; only the installment must be flagged

S-07.scenario: Long call: an allowed hedged remark early ('ola bilər'), a guaranteed 10% price growth buried near the end
S-07.trap: Long context: hedged statement must be ignored, the definite one must be caught

S-08.scenario: Client repeats a competitor's 'price will surely grow 20%'; manager explicitly refuses to guarantee it
S-08.trap: The guarantee words appear in the call, but nobody from our side promised anything

S-09.scenario: Speaker labels swapped by the telephony: the manager's 7% discount line is tagged as client
S-09.trap: Known limitation: the agent trusts speaker labels, so a mislabeled manager promise is likely missed

S-10.scenario: Compliant 3% discount for full payment, said in words ('üç faiz')
S-10.trap: Number in words: if the value comes back as 'üç', the code reports a discount without a percentage (false alarm)
